fields.null_handling: reject the row, a customer without an id cannot be keyed
fields.effective_date_behaviour: not dated, the key is stable for the life of the record
fields.reconciliation_rule: every accepted source customer_id appears exactly once in golden.csv

fields.transformation: strip spaces and hyphens, keep 13 digits
fields.authority: registry for existence, sales_master for assignment
fields.null_handling: keep the customer, mark it unmatched, never guess a number
fields.reconciliation_rule: every non empty houjin_bangou in golden.csv exists in registry.csv

fields.transformation: copy the registered name for the row's houjin_bangou
fields.authority: registry, the requirement makes the register authoritative for the legal name
fields.null_handling: no registry row means no legal name, the field stays empty and the row counts as unmatched
fields.effective_date_behaviour: UNKNOWN, the requirement does not say whether a corrected legal name applies from the registry update date or from the migration date
fields.reconciliation_rule: all golden rows sharing one houjin_bangou carry the same legal_name, and that name equals registry.registered_name

fields.transformation: copy verbatim, no normalization, no registry substitution
fields.authority: sales_master, the requirement preserves the existing sales facing name
fields.null_handling: reject the row, a customer with no sales facing name cannot be used by sales
fields.effective_date_behaviour: not dated, the existing name is carried forward as is
fields.reconciliation_rule: commercial_name in golden.csv equals the source name for the same customer_id and is never overwritten by legal_name

fields.transformation: STORE when store_id is present, CORPORATE when it is empty
fields.null_handling: an empty store_id means CORPORATE, never a missing value
fields.reconciliation_rule: one CORPORATE row per houjin_bangou group that has a corporate source row

fields.transformation: copy, and require the store to exist in stores.csv
fields.effective_date_behaviour: the store record carries its own validity, see valid_from and valid_to
fields.reconciliation_rule: every non empty store_id in golden.csv exists in stores.csv, orphan count 0

fields.transformation: copy, and require the parent to be a CORPORATE record carrying the same houjin_bangou
fields.authority: sales_master, constrained by the requirement that the hierarchy is kept rather than merged
fields.effective_date_behaviour: the link carries the child store validity, see links.csv
fields.reconciliation_rule: no cycle, no store parent, relationship_mismatch 0

fields.authority: UNKNOWN, the requirement does not rule between the sales system and CRM, the sales master value is carried forward unchanged and the question is escalated
fields.null_handling: keep the row, leave the field empty, never default to a number nobody agreed
fields.reconciliation_rule: payment_terms_days in golden.csv equals the sales master value for the same customer_id, attribute_mismatch 0

fields.source_field: stores.valid_from for a store record, registry.registered_from for a corporate record
fields.authority: stores for a store record, registry for a corporate record
fields.null_handling: reject the store row, a store with no opening date cannot be dated
fields.effective_date_behaviour: this field is the effective date of the record itself
fields.reconciliation_rule: valid_from is not later than valid_to where both are present

fields.transformation: copy the date, empty when the store is open
fields.null_handling: empty means still valid, never a far future sentinel date
fields.effective_date_behaviour: a closed store keeps its own closing date, the record is retained and never redirected to a newer store
fields.reconciliation_rule: the closed store record is still present in golden.csv with its own valid_to, historical_mismatch 0

fields.transformation: OPEN maps to ACTIVE, CLOSED maps to CLOSED, a corporate record is ACTIVE
fields.null_handling: reject an unknown status word rather than mapping it to ACTIVE
fields.reconciliation_rule: the count of CLOSED rows equals the count of closed stores in stores.csv

fields.transformation: always empty, this scenario performs no merge
fields.authority: the requirement, which forbids automatic merge of store level customers on a shared houjin_bangou
fields.null_handling: empty is the only valid value
fields.reconciliation_rule: merged count is 0 and every merge directive is counted as rejected
